proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for tvheadend, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the tvheadend service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the tvheadend
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
# Set tvheadend's base URL to /tvheadend.
services:
  tvheadend:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.tvheadend.loadbalancer.server.port=9981
      - traefik.http.routers.tvheadend.rule=Host(`example.com`) && PathPrefix(`/tvheadend`)
      - traefik.http.routers.tvheadend.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.tvheadend.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.tvheadend.service=tvheadend
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.tvheadend.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.tvheadend.middlewares=authentik@docker

kubernetes:
# Tvheadend: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-tvheadend/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
# Security notes:
#   - device /dev/dri: Only needed if you want to use your AMD/Intel GPU for hardware accelerated video encoding (vaapi). (needs a device plugin or hostPath; not emitted).
#   - device /dev/dvb: Only needed if you want to pass through a DVB card to the container. If you use IPTV or HDHomeRun you can leave it out. (needs a device plugin or hostPath; not emitted).
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: tvheadend-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: tvheadend
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: tvheadend-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: tvheadend
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: tvheadend-recordings
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: tvheadend
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: tvheadend
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: tvheadend
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: tvheadend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: tvheadend
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: tvheadend
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/tvheadend:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: tvheadend-env
        ports:
        - name: port-9981
          containerPort: 9981
          protocol: TCP
        - name: port-9982
          containerPort: 9982
          protocol: TCP
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tvheadend-config
          mountPath: /config
        - name: tvheadend-recordings
          mountPath: /recordings
      volumes:
      - name: tvheadend-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: tvheadend-config
      - name: tvheadend-recordings
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: tvheadend-recordings
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: tvheadend
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: tvheadend
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: tvheadend
  ports:
  - name: port-9981
    port: 9981
    targetPort: 9981
    protocol: TCP
  - name: port-9982
    port: 9982
    targetPort: 9982
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# tvheadend.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-tvheadend/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Tvheadend (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/tvheadend:latest
ContainerName=tvheadend
AutoUpdate=registry
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
# Environment=RUN_OPTS=
Volume=/path/to/tvheadend/data:/config:Z
Volume=/path/to/recordings:/recordings:Z
PublishPort=9981:9981
PublishPort=9982:9982
# AddDevice=/dev/dri:/dev/dri
# AddDevice=/dev/dvb:/dev/dvb

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
